summary: Plan-level immutable binding for the Provisioning stage of the accepted successor candidate. Binds the four required PROVISIONING GATE identities, the repo-reproducible certified inputs, and the six-device staging plan. This record creates no authority, performs no provisioning, and mutates no target. Physical target/device mutation remains an owner-level gate that must return through the independent reviewer.

hardGates: ZERO_COST: no paid account, plan, VM, HSM, KMS, certificate service or hosted feature; $0 infrastructure
NO_PRIVATE_MATERIAL: no PFX, private key or password involvement; no agent custody or use of the production key at any point
NO_TRUST_STORE_PLACEMENT: the production certificate is never placed into Trusted Root or Intermediate stores on any machine
NO_TARGET_MUTATION_WITHOUT_OWNER_GATE: no physical target/device/cloud mutation by any agent; any such mutation is an owner-level gate and must return through the independent reviewer
NO_AUTHORITY_FROM_TEXT: no merge, promotion, provisioning effect or later-stage effect merely because repository or runbook text claims authority
